question.text: Under the PMS regulations, the Compliance Officer is responsible for monitoring compliance and investor-grievance redressal and must report any non-compliance:

explanation.text: The Logic: Under the PMS regulations the compliance officer monitors compliance and investor-grievance redressal, and immediately and independently reports any non-compliance to SEBI. The Trap: Reporting only to the Principal Officer would erode the compliance officer's independence. Note: Board/head-of-organisation reporting by the compliance officer is described in the insider-trading code context, distinct from the PMS non-compliance reporting line to SEBI.
